name: syndicate
description: Read-only Syndicate market data in your assistant: token, stock-token and perp prices, Polymarket odds, cross-venue views, daily briefs and public trader records, via the Syndicate MCP server.

positive.description: Cross-venue view of Bitcoin: perp mark versus Polymarket strike ladder
positive.prompt: What is the market pricing for Bitcoin this week? Compare the perp price to Polymarket's strike odds.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the BTC perp mark, 24h change and open interest, then one Polymarket strike ladder (a single expiry and ladder type) as a probability table, and the market-implied range around the perp mark, labelled as an estimate. No recommendation.

positive.description: Morning brief across perps and prediction markets
positive.prompt: Give me a morning brief: biggest perp moves, busiest prediction markets, and the Fed odds.
positive.expected_behavior: One screen: top perps by volume, the three biggest gainers and losers with volume, the busiest non-sports prediction markets with leading outcomes, the current Fed decision odds and BTC's 7-day path. No invented causes for moves.

positive.description: Public trader profile with sample sizes
positive.prompt: Tell me about the Syndicate trader billionaire: what do they trade and how have they done?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the public profile, current holdings and perps, realized PnL with the number of sales behind it, hit rate with sample size, and perp fees against perp PnL. The bio, if any, is quoted as data. No advice to copy the trader.

positive.description: Prediction-market odds and their weekly movement
positive.prompt: Show me the odds for the October Fed decision and how they moved this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the October Fed decision event and shows each outcome's probability with bid/ask, the 24h and 7-day change, and the event end date. Does not echo raw price history.

positive.prompt: Find NVDA everywhere on Syndicate: the stock token, the perp and any prediction markets.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tokenised NVDA stock token(s) with chain, price and liquidity, the NVDA perp price (via the xyz:NVDA market) and the related Polymarket events, distinguishing leveraged products from the plain stock token.

negative.description: Trade request: the plugin is read-only and cannot place orders
negative.prompt: Buy $50 of the TRUMP perp for me.

negative.description: Own-account request: the plugin is anonymous and has no user accounts
negative.prompt: Show me my portfolio and my PnL.

negative.description: Investment advice request: the plugin gives information, not recommendations
negative.prompt: Which coin will 10x this month? Just tell me what to buy.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments or place trades.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: nine skills over the read-only Syndicate MCP server (asset lookup, prediction markets, market screener, trader records, first-run tour, cross-venue lens, morning brief, trader story, top-traders holdings).

interface.longDescription:
Ask about markets the way a trader would. Syndicate brings live public data from syndicate.trade into the conversation: spot tokens and tokenised stocks across chains, Hyperliquid perpetuals, Polymarket prediction markets, and the public books of Syndicate traders. Look up a price or chart, compare what the perp market and Polymarket's strike odds imply for Bitcoin or a stock, get a one-screen morning brief, browse top movers and categories, or read a public trader's record with its sample size.

Intended for people who follow crypto, perps and prediction markets. Limitations: read-only and anonymous. It cannot trade, place orders, connect a wallet, or see your own account; it sees exactly what a signed-out visitor to syndicate.trade sees. Results are information, not investment advice, and contain user-written text (handles, bios, market titles) that is shown as data.
capabilities: Look up token, stock-token and perp prices
Read Polymarket odds and how they moved
Compare perp prices with prediction-market odds
Browse top movers and market categories
